# Paragraph-frame default compatibility

These original, minimal DOCX packages are generated by
`tools/paragraph_frame_defaults_fixture.py`, without using the application
serializer or another document engine. All 15 packages pass the official
ECMA-376 transitional document/style schemas. No font binaries are included.

Each `*-native.json` is bound to the exact source SHA-256 and records the
reference frame metadata and collapsed paragraph insertion coordinates.
The reference-opening helper confirmed each exact input before a separate
read-only reference application instance repaginated it. Before/after source hashes matched.
Insertion coordinates are not glyph-ink bounds; COM alignment sentinels and
0.05-point position rounding are not renderer offsets.

ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.3.1.11 specifies page-relative omitted anchors and an
automatic omitted height rule. The reference application instead uses text-relative omitted
anchors and a minimum height when a positive `h` is present. The reference application treats an
explicit zero height as automatic even with `hRule="exact"`. These deviations
are documented in [MS-OE376 §2.1.48](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_standards/ms-oe376/6ff920ba-f035-407d-aa15-c4e2ad916cb6).

Additional native controls establish that an omitted `h` with an explicit
`exact` or `atLeast` rule takes its requested height from `w`: widths of 72,
120 and 180 points produce the same respective requested heights. This
behavior is empirical; it is not stated in that implementation note. Zero or
omitted width leaves sizing automatic. A six-point minimum grows to fit text,
whereas an explicit automatic rule ignores a positive requested height.

Layout resolves these defaults without synthesizing source attributes.
The unit and browser tests cover native positions, narrow-frame line wrapping,
minimum sizing, editing, retained package parts and byte-exact undo.

Earlier diagnostic fixtures had `framePr` after `spacing`, violating the
paragraph-property sequence. They are excluded from this fixture set and from
the final proof. These corrected source packages were validated and recaptured
in the reference application; their references do not reuse the earlier hashes.

This does not implement paragraph frames in section columns, drop caps,
section-ending frames, multi-page frames, or explicit frames in table cells.
